task.title: Kanban Board (Drag & Drop)
task.buildPrompt: Build a Kanban board with 3 columns: To Do, In Progress, Done. Users can add cards to any column, drag cards between columns, edit card title inline, and delete cards. Show a card count per column header. Persist state in-memory only.

checks.description: Adding a card to 'To Do' via add-card input appears in the correct column only
checks.expected: card only in To Do column

checks.description: Dragging a card from 'To Do' to 'In Progress' moves the DOM node
Card count in column header updates after add/move/delete
checks.expected: count increments after adding card, or count not shown

checks.description: Double-clicking a card title allows inline edit and persists new value on blur/Enter
Deleting a card removes only that card, other cards in same column remain
checks.expected: only target card removed, siblings intact

checks.description: Reload behavior is consistent with prompt (no-persistence = empty; persistence = cards survive)
checks.expected: board renders after reload; cards should not survive (in-memory only)

task.title: Product Catalog with Cart
task.buildPrompt: Build a product catalog page (8-10 mock products with name, price, image placeholder) with search-by-name filtering, category filter dropdown, and an 'Add to Cart' button per product. Include a cart drawer/sidebar showing items, quantities, per-item and total price, with quantity +/- controls and remove button.

checks.description: Typing a product name substring in search filters visible products to matching items only
Selecting a category filter shows only products of that category
Search + category filter applies simultaneously (AND logic)
checks.expected: AND logic: combined is ≤ filter-only count

checks.description: Clicking 'Add to Cart' increments cart badge count and adds item to drawer
Adding the same product twice increases quantity rather than creating duplicate line item
checks.error:
locator.click: Timeout 2000ms exceeded.
Call log:
[2m  - waiting for locator('button:has-text("Add to Cart"), button:has-text("Add")').first()[22m

checks.description: Increasing quantity via + button updates line total AND grand total
Removing an item from cart updates grand total and removes it from DOM
Cart total is mathematically correct: sum(price × quantity)
